scope: Native-derived target-conditioned speech only. Main/Full conditional accuracy and all-plan rates retained separately. Sampling fixes uniquely named enabled button/link slots, not representative element/site coverage. Raw website content and utterances stay local. No Navigation Accuracy, whole-engine State Accuracy, Task Success or Native completion claim.
methodology: First v1 was initially unseen; its recovery and document-readiness reruns are inspected protocol development. V2 uses new excluded-domain sampling after helper/model freeze. All same-site attempts remain separate, never pooled as independent samples. Target attributes come from pre-request AX, not speech. Native keyboard focus selects setup only; actual reading-target quality still uses independently visible geometry/AX.
metadataIssues: The v1 recovery plan inherited prose saying all list ancestry was unsupported; its frozen helper source already supported AXContentList. The original prose and all source hashes/data remain intact. Ready/v2 plan descriptions correct this.
Original v1 checked the source URL before archiving that failed AX snapshot; no missing source observation is reconstructed. Later attempts journal raw document probes before readiness validation.
